item.title: Here’s Where to Buy Affordable Tickets to aespa’s SYNK: COMPLaeXITY Tour Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. Today, we're excited to share the latest news about K-pop sensation aespa. They're embarking on their fourth world tour, titled SYNK: COMPLaeXITY, and we've got all the details you need to know."
[Music transitions to a brief K-pop clip]
Host: "The four-member group, consisting of Karina, Giselle, Winter, and Ningning, announced their tour on April 21st, alongside the news of their second studio album, LEMONADE, set to release on May 29th. The tour will take them to North America, Latin America, Europe, and Taipei, with stops in major cities like Hamilton, Washington D.C., Los Angeles, and Paris."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "During the tour, fans can expect an exciting mix of solo and group performances, featuring tracks from their past albums and songs from their upcoming album, LEMONADE. And the best part? You can be a part of it. Tickets are now available, and we've got the scoop on where to find affordable options."
[Music transitions to a brief ticketing segment]
Host: "Ticketmaster is the official retailer, with general admission tickets available as of May 6th. You can also check out StubHub, SeatGeek, and Vivid Seats for competitive pricing. In fact, we've seen prices as low as $100 on Vivid Seats, $110 on SeatGeek, and $123 on StubHub. And, with promo codes like BILLBOARD10 on SeatGeek, you can score an extra $10 off your purchase."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "So, don't miss out on aespa's SYNK: COMPLaeXITY tour. Get your tickets now and experience the energy and excitement of K-pop live. For more information and to purchase tickets, check out the links in our show notes. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard, and we'll catch you in the next episode."
[Outro music plays]
